rules.images: Extract installed artwork and verify rendered controls locally. Never ship game pixels.
rules.coordinates: Reference rectangles are search hints only; current screen and target identity must be verified before input.
rules.dynamic_menu: No fixed position, row or ordering. Match icons throughout current menu.
rules.scrolling: Recognize visible rows on entry, then locate controls relative to the current row or section; never assume scroll starts at top.
rules.ownership: Account-specific names, counts, unlocks and loadouts are learned locally.
rules.unknown: Unknown or ambiguous controls stop input; absence is not a locked-state proof.

home.label: Home
rules: Claim Ad Gems can disappear and shift the left column.
Difficulty controls change tier; verify the displayed tier after each input.
Preset button and selected-preset text only exist when available.

cards.label: Cards
rules: Crop icons from inventory without changing deck. Read names, stars, mastery and green equipped check separately.
Locks indicate cards cannot be swapped during a run. Discover full inventory; no fixed six-card limit.
Presets and equipped slot count vary. Buying cards is opt-in spending, never setup.

modules.label: Modules
rules: Four primary slots; optional assists must be examined but never purchased during scan.
Equipped modules are absent from inventory. Capture full slot identities before any unequip.
Crop inventory art first, then open descriptor to identify the clicked tile.
Restoration must verify every saved primary and assist assignment before reporting completion.

guild.label: Guild
rules: Four weekly chest positions; distinguish collected, claimable and locked.

guardians.label: Guardians
rules: Chip inventory logical positions are fixed; unlocks and presets vary. Equipped slots and inventory are distinct.

guild_store.label: Guild Store
rules: Scrollable sections Currencies, Themes, Relics and Guardian chips; locate items relative to headings. No purchases for mapping.

bots.label: Bots
rules: Presets vary up to user-described five. Owned bots differ; detect On/Off state, never unlock for mapping.

shop.label: Shop
rules: Free gem card identified by gem icon, x20 and Free text. Limited offers can shift its position.
Only free gem claims supported automatically; paid offers and website gift excluded.

tournament.label: Tournament

tournament_info.label: Occasional tournament information

collection.note: Do not assume initial scroll at top. Heat has Level, Overheat has Wave; content is event-dependent.

daily_missions.label: Daily missions
rules: Quest claim is relative to its card. Weekly rewards scroll horizontally and are identified by threshold and state.

event_missions.label: Event missions
rules: Quest tiers award 10, 15, 20 medals; boost doubles rewards. Daily claim limit and event quest progress are separate.
Reward relic claim is relative to its relic slot; paid and free tracks are distinct.

event_shop.label: Event shop
rules: Sections move with scroll. Themes, relics and songs use section-relative item positions.
Currency and shard purchases are manual-only; optional theme/relic buying requires explicit policy and budget.
Two standard relics and four rotating relics were described; detect actual availability and prices.

themes.label: Themes
rules: Top tabs: Profile, Themes, Relics. Category tabs: Tower, Background, Music, Menus.
Quest skin swap must save original, equip another, restore original and verify.

battle_history.label: Battle History
rules: Rows identify a run by multiple fields, not skin icon alone.

battle_report.label: Battle report
rules: Read labels and values; Copy offers a text export. Verify run identity.

global_presets.label: Global presets
rules: Top preset loads five assignments: Workshop, Cards, Bots, Modules, Guardians.
Changing a lower selection edits the selected global preset. Names and counts are account-local.

workshop.label: Workshop
rules: Entire Workshop is manual-only; never upgrade, enhance, respec or open Ultimate Weapons for setup.

perks_first.label: First Perk
rules: User preference must be configurable; no universal selection.

perks_ban.label: Ban Perks
rules: Selected slots lie between section titles; number unlocked varies. Green tick on available card indicates selected.

perks_priority.label: Auto Pick priority

module_detail.label: Module details
rules: Read name after opening the clicked inventory tile; match detail art to the source tile.

module_role.label: Primary or Assist
rules: Verify module identity before choosing role.

module_merge.label: Merge modules
rules: Preview lists proposed merges with checkboxes; confirm only under enabled merge policy.

module_shatter.label: Shatter modules
rules: Locked modules are protected. Selection toggles; maximum 12 per batch per user.

guardian_detail.label: Guardian chip details

labs.label: Labs

lab_values.label: Research range values

reward_reveal.label: Reward reveal

results.label: Game stats
